buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Technical Specifications & Quality Standards ISI/BIS Certification: Products supplied must be ISI-certified (wherever applicable), brand new, in good condition, and strictly as per the technical specifications outlined i n the bid. Genuineness & Prohibition of Second-Hand Goods: All items supplied must be 1 00% genuine, authentic, and of the original brand. Supplying second-hand, refurbishe d, duplicate, replica, or counterfeit products is strictly prohibited. Any violation will le ad to immediate rejection of the goods and strict penal action. Packaging & Inspection: Items must be delivered in original manufacturer packagi

ng with proper labelling, warranty cards, and standard accessories. Delivered goods will undergo strict inspection by the buyer's committee, and any sub-standard items will be rejected outright at the supplier's sole risk and cost. 2. Delivery Schedule & Liquidated Damages (Late Penalty) Timeline: Items must be delivered within the stipulated delivery period as mentione d in the bid. Late Penalty: If delivery is delayed beyond the expected delivery date, a penalty de duction of 0.5% per week (or part thereof) of the undelivered value will be automatica lly enforced. 3. Cancellation Rights & Rejection Policy Cancellation: If the bid is cancelled by the buyer for administrative reasons, the sell er shall not raise any objections. Return of Rejected Goods: If goods are rejected for any reason during inspection, t he seller is fully responsible for taking them back at their own cost within the specifie d timeframe. 4. Financial Turnover Requirement (Gujarat State Procurement Policy 2024) Bidders must have an average minimum annual turnover of ₹2.48 Lakh over the last 3-year period, supported exclusively by a valid Chartered Accountant (CA) certificate. Startup Exemption: Startups recognized by DPIIT, holding a valid Udyam certificate, and registered as MSEs with CSPO or NSIC are exempt from prior experience and mini mum turnover requirements, provided their annual production capacity is at least twi ce the bid quantity. (Note: Resellers/traders do not qualify for startup benefits). 5. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) Details Advisory Bank & Schedule-wise EMD Breakdown: An EMD amount payable in fa vor of "PRINCIPAL ITI VYARA payable at VYARA" is mandatory under the Gujarat State Procurement Policy 2024, structured schedule-wise as follows: Details / Amount (In IN ईईएएममडड ववववररणण // EMD Detail R) एएडडववााइइजजरर बबकक // Advisory Bank State Bank of India Schedule 1 576 Schedule 2 312 Schedule 3 210 Schedule 4 156 Schedule 5 450 Schedule 6 270 Schedule 7 480 Schedule 8 426 Schedule 9 81 Schedule 10 18 Schedule 11 180

Schedule 12 210 Schedule 13 360 EMD Exemption Eligibility & Rules: Submission of Valid Supporting Documents / Exemption Criteria: The bi dder seeking EMD exemption must submit the valid supporting document for th e relevant category as per GeM GTC with the bid. Under the MSE category, only manufacturers for goods and service providers for services are eligible for exem ption from EMD. Traders are strictly excluded from the purview of this policy. Eligible Entities: MSE Manufacturers/Service Providers with valid Udyam and CSPO/NSIC re gistration. DPIIT-recognized Startups with Udyam and CSPO/NSIC registration as MSE s. Bidders verified through the GeM Vendor Assessment process for the prim ary product category. High-turnover OEMs or service providers with an annual turnover of INR 5 00 Crore or more. Sellers holding a valid BIS license for the primary product category. Schedule-Wise EMD & Letterhead Self-Certification Undertaking: The EMD amount will be applicable for each schedule/group selected during Bid creation. Seller Undertaking: If the seller chooses to participate in specific selected sch edules, the seller must submit a formal declaration/undertaking on their official letterhead certifying the specific schedules chosen and confirming that the tot al payable EMD corresponding to those selected schedules has been fully paid ( or valid exemption proof for those schedules has been attached). Beneficiary Details: EMD & Performance Security should be in favor of the Benefici ary, wherever applicable. Form of Deposit: Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) shall also be accepted by the buyer in the form of a surety bond. .
